cases.text: At first light, the city seems almost still. Delivery trucks turn onto empty streets, kitchen lights come on, and the day begins before most people notice.
cases.speaker: Aiden
cases.instruction: Speak naturally and calmly, like a thoughtful documentary narrator. Avoid a promotional tone.

cases.text: Look, I hear you. But if we're going to change the plan, let's do it now, while we still have room to make it work.
cases.speaker: Ryan
cases.instruction: Keep it informal, direct, and conversational, with natural rhythm. Do not sound like an announcer.

cases.text: Keep your voice down. There is someone in the next room, and I do not want them to know we are still awake.
cases.speaker: Aiden
cases.instruction: Whisper quietly and cautiously, close to the microphone, while keeping the words intelligible.

cases.text: Step away from the railing. Do it slowly, and keep your eyes on me. We have time, but I need you to listen now.
cases.speaker: Ryan
cases.instruction: Use controlled urgency: firm and focused, slightly faster than normal, but do not shout.

cases.text: There it is. After all those years of looking, the signal was waiting in the quietest part of the sky.
cases.speaker: Aiden
cases.instruction: Start softly with quiet wonder, then let restrained amazement grow toward the end.

cases.text: On Thursday, February nineteenth, Dr. Maya Chen approved version 3.7. The total was 14,805 dollars and 60 cents, reference code A Z nine forty-two.
cases.speaker: Aiden
cases.instruction: Read this practical information naturally, with special care for names, dates, numbers, and the reference code.
